warning: TEST-ONLY MATERIAL. These keys and constants exist only to make the golden vectors deterministic and replayable. Never use any value from this file in a production build, and never ship a binary containing them (pairing.md §11.3: test-only bypasses live behind compile-time test features; production binaries contain no runtime path to them).

client_identity_key.derivation: d = SHA-256("audio-share v2 TEST-ONLY client identity key (do not use in production)") mod n

client_signing_nonce.derivation: k = SHA-256("audio-share v2 TEST-ONLY ECDSA nonce | " + <label>) mod n

labels.auth-happy-path: audio-share v2 TEST-ONLY ECDSA nonce | auth-happy-path
labels.pairing-confirm-qr: audio-share v2 TEST-ONLY ECDSA nonce | pairing-confirm-qr
labels.pairing-confirm-sas: audio-share v2 TEST-ONLY ECDSA nonce | pairing-confirm-sas

client_signing_nonce.note: ECDSA k is normally per-signature randomness; the vectors pin one k per signature so the recorded 64-byte r||s is reproducible. Implementations VERIFY the recorded signatures (deterministic); they never reproduce them.

server_identity_key.derivation: seed = SHA-256("audio-share v2 TEST-ONLY server identity key (do not use in production)"); PKCS#8 DER = 302e020100300506032b657004220420 || seed
server_identity_key.note: The pin (SHA-256 of the SPKI DER) is recorded for the fingerprint path (pairing.md §7.4); no vector verifies the Server key — CertificateVerify is inside TLS and out of vector scope.

fixed_randomness.note: CSPRNG outputs are fixture-fixed constants in the vectors; production uses a CSPRNG.

fixed_exporter_outputs.note: TLS-Exporter outputs are connection-scoped secrets (pairing.md §6.3); the vectors fix them as constants so signatures and the recorded binding_context values are verifiable without a TLS session.

derivation_assumptions: pairing.md §6.3 TLV(1, mode): encoded as the pairing.md §6.2 ASCII mode string ('qr' / 'sas'). SPEC GAP: the accepted spec does not state the mode encoding in the binding; flagged to the maintainer in ticket 05 (one-line fixture change if adjudicated otherwise).
pairing.md §6.3/§9.1 TLV(*, protocol_major): encoded as u32 big-endian, consistent with capabilities_canonical's u32 BE ids. SPEC GAP: encoding not stated; flagged.

spec.md §4.1's band table lists oneof cases 1–6 for band 1–15 while §4.4 defines Negotiate/NegotiateResponse in that band without case numbers; they are assigned 7 and 8 in protos/wire-protocol-v2/control.proto. SPEC GAP: flagged to the maintainer.

spec.md §7.5 lists 'reserved flag bits set' as malformed media while §7.1 and the §12 parked row say reserved bits are ignored (accepted with D4); vectors follow the adjudicated ignore rule. SPEC GAP: flagged.

spec.md §5.2 writes PairingResult(201, detail "declined") for the approval-declined row while §4.2/TM-6 forbid detail in pre-auth responses; the declined case is NOT vectorized (both readings agree on code 201 + Close) and the conflict is flagged.
